intro.data: A functor takes a machine and hands you a SECOND machine that runs it across a whole batch at once — many records in, many records out, the same job done to each one. The plain Cleaner (shown at right) cleans one record. Its lift is in the tray: the machine that takes a batch and cleans every record. Bring the true lift onto the board and wire it; the impostor lift wrecks the records, so leave it in the tray.
intro.alchemy: A functor takes an apparatus and hands you a SECOND apparatus that runs it across a whole crate at once — many ores in, many ingots out, the same job done to each one. The plain Smelter (shown at right) refines one ore. Its lift is in the tray: the apparatus that takes a crate and refines every ore. Bring the true lift onto the board and wire it; the impostor lift wrecks the ore, so leave it in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: A functor takes a working and hands you a SECOND working that runs it across a whole flock at once — many sparks in, many flames out, the same job done to each one. The plain Kindler (shown at right) kindles one spark. Its lift is in the tray: the working that takes a flock and kindles every spark. Bring the true lift onto the board and wire it; the impostor lift wrecks the sparks, so leave it in the tray.
intro.abstract: F(x) means the value x lifted into the batch world (the box holding x), and a functor's lift F(f) does f to each item inside the box — so here F(3) ↦ F(4). From the tray bring the faithful lift F(f) and wire F(A) to F(B); the impostor is the lift of some OTHER machine (it sends F(3) ↦ F(9)), so leave it behind.

goal.data: Bring the right batch machine from the tray and wire a batch of raw records to a batch of clean records, leaving the impostor in the tray.
goal.alchemy: Bring the right crate apparatus from the tray and wire a crate of ore to a crate of ingots, leaving the impostor in the tray.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the right flock working from the tray and wire a flock of sparks to a flock of flames, leaving the impostor in the tray.
goal.abstract: Bring F(f) from the tray and wire F(A) to F(B), leaving the impostor lift behind.

description.data: the Cleaner run on a whole batch — cleans every record, same as the plain Cleaner does to one
description.alchemy: the Smelter run on a whole crate — refines every ore, same as the plain Smelter does to one
description.spellcraft: the Kindler run on a whole flock — kindles every spark, same as the plain Kindler does to one
description.abstract: the faithful lift of f: sends F(3) ↦ F(4) (does f to each item in the box)

description.data: a DIFFERENT machine run on the batch — shreds every record, so it is not the lift of the Cleaner
description.alchemy: a DIFFERENT apparatus run on the crate — crushes every ore, so it is not the lift of the Smelter
description.spellcraft: a DIFFERENT working run on the flock — smothers every spark, so it is not the lift of Kindler
description.abstract: sends F(3) ↦ F(9) — does NOT lift f (the lift of some other machine)

afterSuccess.data: The Batch Cleaner is the lift of the Cleaner: hand it a batch and it returns a batch, cleaning every record exactly the way the plain Cleaner cleans one. A functor is the rule behind that — it pairs each type A with a batched type F(A) and each machine f with its batched machine F(f).
afterSuccess.alchemy: The Crate Smelter is the lift of the Smelter: hand it a crate and it returns a crate, refining every ore exactly the way the plain Smelter refines one. A functor is the rule behind that — it pairs each material A with a crated form F(A) and each apparatus f with its crate version F(f).
afterSuccess.spellcraft: The Flock Kindler is the lift of Kindler: hand it a flock and it returns a flock, kindling every spark exactly the way the plain Kindler kindles one. A functor is the rule behind that — it pairs each essence A with a flock form F(A) and each working f with its flock version F(f).
afterSuccess.abstract: You built F(f), the lift of f: it runs f on every item of a wrapped value. A functor pairs each object A with a wrapped F(A) and each morphism f with its lift F(f).

reveal.summary: A functor pairs each type A with a wrapped type F(A) (e.g. a batch of A), and each machine f : A → B with a lifted machine F(f) : F(A) → F(B) that runs f on every item.
notation: f: A → B  ↦  F(f): F(A) → F(B)
reveal.moreFormal: F must also preserve identities and composition (next puzzles). List, Optional, and Batch are all functors: F wraps each type, and F(f) runs f on every item inside the wrapper.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: Like List.map: f: (a: A) => B lifts to map(f): (xs: List<A>) => List<B>, running f on every element.
